method.lines: A spoken line is an entry of atlas/spoken-lines/lines-*.json whose "line" is non-empty (74 turns are silent action). Lines are matched to scenes exactly by their METIS turn id, OD-Bnn-Snn-Tnn, whose prefix is the scene id; the speaker of each is the "sp" of the same turn id in viewer/performance-turns.json (the line files carry no speaker). "dialogue" excludes the narrator (PERFORMER.NARRATOR); "lines" includes it.
method.locations: A scene's location is what its scene file places: `import … from "../assets/location/<id>.mjs"` and `asset:"location.<id>"` in its code (comments stripped). The atlas's own location ids are kept as atlas_locations; nine of them name no asset (the film folded them into megaron-hall and weapon-storeroom) and appear as atlas_aliases. 24 scenes that place no location are given one by hand (INFERRED, location_source "inferred", with the reason); 4 at open sea are left unplaced. A scene that places two sets counts its lines at both.
method.landscape: Terrain: the id decides the primary kind when it names one (shore, cave, hall…); otherwise, and for the secondary kinds, keyword counts over the texts (the asset's own header weighted 3x). Vegetation, roads, water, architecture, time and weather: fixed word lists matched in the location asset's header comment ("asset"), the atlas registry's description of it ("atlas") and the header comment and beats of every scene set there (scene id). Each term keeps its sources and a snippet. A term named only in the text of one scene (not by the asset or atlas) is set apart in mentioned_once, since it may belong to a place the scene only mentions; terms named in two scenes, or a fifth of a set's scenes when it has more than ten, are kept. Secondary terrain kinds are read from the asset and atlas only. States are the asset's own `states` nodes.
method.costumes: Figures are the character/ensemble/creature assets placed in the scenes set there. "wears" is lifted from the figure's own asset header (sentences naming clothing or things carried); "staged" from the scene header sentences naming the figure and a garment or object.
method.flags: has_location_card: odyssey/cards/<location>.mpd exists. has_keyframes: odyssey/keyframes/<scene>/sheet.jpg. in_film: film-readymades/build_odyssey.py SCENES. kit: kitpages.SCENES plus the scene files named in each kit.json "sources"; a location also has a kit when a kit.json names its asset file. A slug in kitpages.SCENES with no kit on disk is listed as kits_planned, not as a kit.

Leave my halls; feast somewhere else, eat your own stores house to house. Or stay and devour on, and I will cry to the gods who live forever that a day of reckoning come, and you die in this house unavenged.

If I hear he lives and is coming home, I can hold out one year more; if I hear he is dead, I will raise his mound, pay him all the honors owed, and give my mother to a husband.

scenes.title: Athena Answers on the Shore

scenes.title: The Night Launch
scenes.first_line: Meet me at the swift ship by nightfall, friends. We sail tonight.

scenes.title: Arrival at Poseidon's Sacrifice

key_beat.note: no more shyness, not now

scenes.title: The Chariot Road to Sparta

scenes.first_line: Quickly now, my sons, harness the flowing-maned horses to the car for Telemachus, and let the housekeeper load bread and wine and such meats as kings' sons feed on. He has far to drive before nightfall.

scenes.title: The Double Wedding at Sparta
scenes.book_title: The King and Queen of Sparta
scenes.first_line: Softly, son of Nestor — there is a feast within, a wedding song.

scenes.first_line: Yet for no man of them all do I grieve as for Odysseus, who labored at Troy beyond us all. His absence is sorrow to old Laertes, to steady Penelope, and to Telemachus, the child he left new-born in his hall.

scenes.book_title: The King and Queen of Sparta

scenes.first_line: True, wife — yet you tell only half. Hear the horse's tale from within: I crouched in that timber belly with the best of the Argives, and Odysseus held command of us all, when you came circling in the dark.

scenes.title: The Gifts and the Eagle Omen
scenes.book_title: The King and Queen of Sparta

scenes.book_title: The King and Queen of Sparta

scenes.first_line: Hermes of the golden wand — an honored guest, and a rare one. Sit, and let me set ambrosia and red nectar before you. What errand brings you across so much salt water? Speak it; my heart says do it, if it can be done.

scenes.first_line: Here at the island's edge the tall trees stand — alder and poplar and sky-high fir, long dry, that will ride light on the water. Take the great bronze axe and the adze; here is cloth for a sail and cord to lace her. Build, and I will bring all the rest.

scenes.title: Poseidon Breaks the Sea
scenes.first_line: So — the gods changed their minds about Odysseus while I feasted far away. Yet even now I will give him his fill of trouble.

scenes.title: The River Accepts the Castaway

scenes.first_line: Nausicaa.

Far off lies an island where the goddess Calypso held me seven years against my will, and when at last I sailed, the sea broke my raft and threw me naked on your shore. It was your daughter who found me, fed me, and gave me these clothes — blame her for nothing, for I chose to walk behind alone, fearing men's idle talk.

scenes.book_title: A Day for Songs and Contests

This seems to my own heart the fairest thing there is.

scenes.title: Escape beneath the Rams

scenes.title: Aeolus and the Bag of Winds

scenes.title: The Laestrygonian Harbor

scenes.title: Circe Transforms the Crew

scenes.title: Hermes Gives the Moly
scenes.first_line: Bind on my sword and say no more, Eurylochus. Necessity drives — I go alone.

scenes.title: Odysseus Defeats Circe's Spell

scenes.title: The Son Reaches the Hut

key_beat.note: keep your seat, stranger

scenes.first_line: Down, good dogs. You still know my step.

scenes.title: Eumaeus Carries News to Penelope

key_beat.note: a Cretan, then — he is deciding whether to believe it

scenes.first_line: A Cretan, then, and hard luck carried you here. Eumaeus, go quietly to my mother and tell her I am home. Her ears only, no crier in the yard.

scenes.title: The Father Reveals Himself

key_beat.note: you are not my father; this is terror, not doubt

scenes.first_line: Stand straight, son of Laertes. The years come off you now.

scenes.title: The Plan against the Suitors

key_beat.note: counting a hundred and eight men he intends to fight

scenes.first_line: The Phaeacians rowed me home asleep and left me with their gifts on the shore. Now tell me plainly: how many suitors, and out of what houses?

scenes.title: The Ambush Fails and the Suitors Divide

key_beat.note: your own father came here hunted

scenes.first_line: Ship the oars. We are inside the point, and their sail is nowhere.

scenes.title: The Beggar Returns

key_beat.note: the prince is home and safe

scenes.first_line: Bend down again, old wanderer. The swineherd is on the path, and he must find nothing here but rags.

scenes.title: Telemachus Returns to the Palace

key_beat.note: every honour but no news

scenes.first_line: Eumaeus, bring the stranger down to town later in the day and let him beg his bread where he can. I go ahead to the house at first light.

scenes.title: The Road with Melanthius
scenes.first_line: Lean on the staff, old man. The town road is long and my legs are older than they look.

scenes.title: Argos Recognizes His Master
scenes.first_line: Eumaeus, that dog on the heap. There is a fine shape under all that dirt. Was he a hunter once, or only a table dog kept for show?

scenes.title: The Beggar Enters His Hall

key_beat.note: the king begging in his own hall

scenes.first_line: Wait here at the threshold, friend, and come in when I call you.

scenes.title: Antinous Throws the Stool

key_beat.note: I had a house and men of my own once

scenes.first_line: I had a house and men of my own once, and I gave to any beggar who came. Then Egypt swallowed it. My crew were cut down along the river and I was sold from hand to hand until I came to this door.

scenes.title: Penelope Summons the Stranger

key_beat.note: they struck a guest in my own house

scenes.first_line: They struck a guest in my own house and he bore it without a sound? Eumaeus, bring the man up to me. I want to hear where he has wandered, and whether he has heard any word of Odysseus.

scenes.title: Eumaeus Leaves the Hall

key_beat.note: the pigs want me before dawn

scenes.first_line: The pigs want me before dawn, my lord. Shall I go back up to the farm tonight, or is there something here you want done first?

scenes.title: Irus Challenges the Stranger
scenes.first_line: Peace, friend. This threshold is wide enough for two hungry men.

scenes.title: Odysseus Drops Irus
scenes.first_line: Look, then. The rags come up, and you may all see what the sea left me.

scenes.title: The Warning to Amphinomus
scenes.first_line: Amphinomus, of all these men you seem to carry sense, so hear me. Earth breeds nothing feebler than a man, and no man should walk lawless because the season is kind to him.

scenes.title: Penelope Appears before the Suitors
scenes.first_line: Go down among them, Penelope, and shine. Let their knees go weak and their hands go to their treasure chests.

scenes.title: Melantho and Eurymachus Attack
scenes.first_line: I go up. Let the house be lit.

scenes.title: The Weapons Leave the Hall

key_beat.note: keep the women shut in until this is done

scenes.first_line: Every spear and every shield goes out of this hall tonight, and quietly. If they ask, the smoke has eaten them. The iron itself draws a man on.

scenes.title: Penelope Begins the Test
scenes.first_line: Bold creature, I hear you, and you will pay for it with your own head. I ordered this guest kept by my hearth, and I will question him myself.

scenes.title: The Stranger Describes Odysseus
scenes.first_line: In Crete they called me Aethon, third son of Deucalion, of the line of Minos. Your husband was driven to my shore by a north wind, and I gave him bread and dark wine for twelve days.

scenes.title: Eurycleia Finds the Scar
scenes.first_line: Eurycleia, rise and wash the feet of your master's age-mate. By now the hands and feet of Odysseus must be worn as this man's are, if he is still under the sun.

scenes.title: The Boar Hunt on Parnassus
scenes.first_line: Come out, then!

scenes.title: The Dream of the Geese

key_beat.note: she sets the contest that ends it

scenes.first_line: Hear my dream, stranger, and tell me what it means. Twenty geese feed at my trough and I love to watch them. Then a great eagle stoops from the mountain and breaks the neck of every one.

scenes.title: The Restless Night
scenes.inferred_reason: the header: the PRODOMOS, the forecourt outside the hall door; the atlas calls it palace-night-interior

key_beat.note: put your arrow in my breast tonight

scenes.first_line: Endure, my heart. You endured worse in the cave of the Cyclops.

scenes.title: Thunder and the Mill Woman
scenes.first_line: Father Zeus, if you led me home over dry land and water, give me two signs. Let a voice speak inside the house, and let your thunder speak outside it.

scenes.title: The Herdsmen Arrive

key_beat.note: mark what I say, and let the gods hear it

scenes.first_line: Up, girls. It is Apollo's feast day. Sweep, wet the floor, rinse every cup.

scenes.title: The Ox Hoof

key_beat.note: be glad you missed

scenes.first_line: Let them plot. A bird flew from the left with a living dove in its claws, and even Amphinomus went pale at it. I will eat at my own table, and no man here will tell me where to sit.

scenes.title: The Hall of Death
scenes.first_line: Night. Night on all of you.

scenes.title: The Contest Is Set

key_beat.note: here is the great bow of Odysseus

scenes.first_line: Hear me, lords. Here is the great bow of Odysseus. Whoever strings it with his own hands and sends an arrow clean through all twelve axes, I will go with that man, and leave this house I came to as a bride.

scenes.title: The Suitors Fail the Bow
scenes.first_line: I cannot bend it. Let another try. But I tell you, this bow will take the life and the breath out of the best men here, and better to die than live on failing at what we came for.

scenes.title: Odysseus Recruits the Herdsmen

key_beat.note: carry the bow to me anyway

scenes.first_line: If Odysseus walked through that gate this hour, which side would you two stand on?

scenes.title: The Beggar Requests the Bow

key_beat.note: no guest is refused in my house

scenes.first_line: Hear me, lords. Let me put my hands on the bow, only to learn whether any strength is left in these arms, or whether the road has eaten it all.

scenes.title: The Doors Are Secured
scenes.first_line: Bolt them. Nobody comes out, whatever you hear.

scenes.title: The Bow Sings

key_beat.note: the stranger has not disgraced you — the turn

scenes.first_line: Hear that. It still sings.

scenes.title: Antinous Falls

key_beat.note: you dogs. you never thought I would come home

scenes.first_line: Now for another mark, one no man here has hit.

scenes.title: Eurymachus Bargains and Attacks

key_beat.note: my hands would not stop

scenes.first_line: Antinous is dead, and he was the cause of all of it. Take back the worth of everything we ate, and twenty oxen from each man besides.

scenes.title: The Storeroom Arms the Defenders
scenes.first_line: Father, I will bring arms. Four shields, four helmets, eight spears, for us and the two herdsmen.

scenes.title: Melanthius Arms the Suitors

key_beat.note: someone is arming them out of my own storeroom

scenes.first_line: Take heart. There is a way up to the storeroom. Twelve shields, twelve spears, twelve helmets, and I will bring them down.

scenes.title: Athena Tests the Battle

key_beat.note: Mentor, keep ruin off me

scenes.first_line: Odysseus, I have not forgotten you.

scenes.title: The Hall Is Cleared
scenes.first_line: Nowhere left to run.

scenes.title: The Disloyal Maids

key_beat.note: twelve of you went the shameless way

scenes.first_line: Twelve of you went the shameless way. You lay with them, and you laughed at me, and you laughed at your queen. Stand out from the others; he knows your names now.

scenes.title: The House Calls Penelope

key_beat.note: not aloud — it is not holy to crow over dead men

scenes.first_line: Rejoice in your heart, old woman, but not aloud. It is not holy to crow over dead men. Bring me fire and sulphur now, and I will cleanse this hall.

scenes.title: Eurycleia Wakes Penelope

key_beat.note: wake and see it with your own eyes

scenes.first_line: Wake, my child, wake and see it with your own eyes. Odysseus is home, here in this house, and every suitor lies dead in the hall. The man you have mourned twenty years is sitting by his own fire.

scenes.title: Penelope Studies the Stranger

key_beat.note: let the singer strike up a wedding tune

scenes.first_line: Mother, no other woman has a heart like this.

scenes.title: The False Wedding Noise

key_beat.note: no other wife would sit across the room

scenes.first_line: Sound the wedding. Dance, all of you, dance loud.

scenes.title: The Bed Test

key_beat.note: the summit: she knows him, and says why she could not

scenes.first_line: Eurycleia, carry the great bed out of the bridal chamber and set it up in the hall. Spread the fleeces and the bright blankets on it for him there.

scenes.title: Odysseus Tells the Remaining Journey

key_beat.note: one labour is still on me

scenes.first_line: One labour is still on me. Tiresias bids me walk inland with an oar on my shoulder until I come to men who know nothing of the sea. Where a stranger calls it a winnowing fan, there I plant it and make my peace with Poseidon.

scenes.title: Departure for Laertes

key_beat.note: stay within doors, and bar them

scenes.first_line: Stay within doors, all of you, and bar them; let no woman lean out to look. Word of the dead will run through the town before noon. See nothing, say nothing, until I send for you.

scenes.title: The Suitors Enter Hades
scenes.first_line: This way, all of you. Come along.

scenes.title: Odysseus Tests Laertes
scenes.first_line: Go on ahead. Kill the best pig and set the fire.

scenes.title: The Scar and the Orchard Trees

key_beat.note: count the trees you gave me when I was a boy

scenes.first_line: Here. The boar of Parnassus left me this.

scenes.title: Laertes Is Restored
scenes.first_line: Master. You are home, you are truly home.

scenes.title: The Families Demand Revenge
scenes.first_line: We were there. A god stood at his shoulder in that hall.

scenes.title: Zeus and Athena Set the Terms
scenes.first_line: Father Zeus, son of Cronos, highest of the lords, tell me what you hide behind that brow. Will you stretch this killing out longer, or set peace between them?

scenes.title: The Last Clash
scenes.first_line: Arms. Now.

scenes.title: Athena Makes Peace
scenes.first_line: Hold, men of Ithaca! Break off this bitter war, and part before more blood is spilled.

figures.name: Eurycleia

figures.name: Amphinomus

figures.name: Theoclymenus
figures.wears: Not an elder like Halitherses but a lean, alert man of RANK on the run: a bloodguilt exile of the Melampus prophetic line, fine robe + cloak gone travel-worn, intense far-seeing eyes, a seer's bearing.

figures.name: Melantho

figures.wears: The mortal shell is complete (weathered skin, a full white loyalist's beard, a long robe and cloak) but one tell leaks through: the eyes stay unnaturally BRIGHT, an over-lit divine glint no old man owns.

figures.name: Philoetius
